A cast copper alloy strip form hinged bow brooch of Roman date. The brooch is formed from a narrow parallel-sided strip bow with bevelled edges and which tapers to a point. There is a band of three punched annulets across the lower part of the head and an inscribed V and two punched annulets at the lower tip.
